_comment: Reference patch for ~/.claude/settings.json — session-reflect hook wiring.
DO NOT overwrite settings.json with this file, and DO NOT `jq -s '.[0] * .[1]'`
it either — the `*` merge operator REPLACES existing arrays rather than
concatenating them. If you already have PreCompact/SessionEnd/SubagentStop
entries in settings.json, that merge would drop them.
Correct merge (append-array), keeping any pre-existing hook entries.
IMPORTANT: env merge is patch-then-user so any pre-existing user env value
(e.g. a custom CLAUDE_CODE_SESSIONEND_HOOKS_TIMEOUT_MS) OVERRIDES the patch
default. Before running this, `jq '.env' ~/.claude/settings.json` to check
what user env you already have — a stale timeout there will silently keep
the patch's 90000 out.
jq --slurpfile p settings-patch.json '
.hooks = (($p[0].hooks // {}) as $ph |
(.hooks // {}) | to_entries as $existing |
($existing + ($ph | to_entries)) | group_by(.key) | map({key: .[0].key, value: (map(.value) | add)}) | from_entries)
' ~/.claude/settings.json > ~/.claude/settings.json.new
# inspect the diff, then: mv ~/.claude/settings.json.new ~/.claude/settings.json
Provides:
- env.CLAUDE_CODE_SESSIONEND_HOOKS_TIMEOUT_MS = 90000  (bounded shutdown wait)
- hooks.PreCompact   -> reflect.sh precompact   (synchronous, 60s cap)
- hooks.SessionEnd   -> reflect.sh sessionend   (detached, non-blocking)
- hooks.SubagentStop -> reflect.sh subagentstop (detached, non-blocking)
See skills/session-reflect/README.md for env vars and artifact layout.
